title: An A/B test with 200,000 users in each arm
intro: Illustrative data, made up for this book. A streaming service tested a new recommendation layout on 200,000 users (B) against the old one (A) on another 200,000, randomly assigned. Users who started a second title: 10,400 on A (5.20 %), 10,700 on B (5.35 %).
